patterns.message: Examples import only public entry points (@laminapdf/sdk, @laminapdf/sdk/worker, @laminapdf/render, @laminapdf/render-hayro), never another folder of the repository: docs/guidelines/examples.md.

deniedGlobals.window: Shared packages must run outside browsers; take what you need as a parameter.
deniedGlobals.navigator: Shared packages must run outside browsers; pass capabilities in from the caller.
deniedGlobals.localStorage: Shared packages must not persist state; let the caller store it.
deniedGlobals.sessionStorage: Shared packages must not persist state; let the caller store it.
deniedGlobals.location: Shared packages must not depend on a page URL; pass it in.
deniedGlobals.HTMLElement: Only browser UI packages may use DOM element types.
deniedGlobals.process: Node-only: pass configuration in from the caller.
deniedGlobals.__dirname: Node-only and CommonJS-only: resolve paths in the caller.
deniedGlobals.__filename: Node-only and CommonJS-only: resolve paths in the caller.
